name: io.github.ai-game-studio/cocos-mcp-bridge
title: Cocos MCP Bridge
description: Sovereign embedded MCP server for Cocos Creator from ai-game-studio/cocos-mcp-bridge. Scene/script execution, project resources, file/scene tools, and built-in AI image generation over a single HTTP endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: COCOS_MCP_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional local Cocos MCP HTTP endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8765/.

environmentVariables.name: COCOS_MCP_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP timeout per request in seconds. Defaults to 120.
